description_expanded: OverviewFront Row in Seacrest - 4 Bikes - steps to Lagoon Community Pool-Private Beach- 3 Minute Walk - `Sea Grace`The Space Sea Grace – Elegant Seacrest Beach Home Steps from the Pool & Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Private Balconies – Enjoy relaxing outdoor spaces in multiple rooms Prime Location – 3-minute walk to the beach & steps from the 12,000 sq ft lagoon pool Spacious Open-Concept Living – Perfect for entertaining & gathering 4 Bedrooms + Bonus Room / 4 Bathrooms – Comfortably accommodates larger groups 4 Adult Bikes Included – Cruise 30A & explore Rosemary & Alys Beach Short Walk to Top Restaurants & Shops – Easy access to the best of 30A dining & shopping Complimentary Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained Driveway Parking for 3 Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to Sea GraceSea Grace is located in the popular community of Seacrest Beach 3 minutes away from the beach. This charming 4 bedroom, with a bonus room, 4 bath home offers an inviting open floor plan with the main living area, dining and kitchen on the second floor. Situated at the front of the community this elegant home offers the best of both worlds - close to the beach and also just steps away from the stunning 12,000 sq ft resort style pool Seacrest is known for. Hungry? You are just quick stroll from some of the best dining along Scenic 30A in Rosemary Beach. Grab coffee in Alys and a drink at Neat.Entering the first floor you will find 2 bedrooms. A king bedroom with private balcony and en suite bath on your right. Common area with stairwell entryway and on the left a bedroom with 2 Queen beds, en suite bath, and private balcony.This common area includes a Full-size bed with a pull-out single trundle.The second floor is the hub of the home with, living, dining and kitchen area, open and spacious with all you need to hang with your crew or entertain others who might be at the beach also. This floor has one king bedroom, private balcony and has a shared full bathroom.This room also has 2 twin beds and its own private balcony.When you are ready to explore, you don't have to go far for awesome shopping and dining venues in neighboring Rosemary and Alys Beach.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (13):Master: King sized bed, private en suite bath and private balconyGuest: 2 Queen, private en suite bath and private balconyGuest: Full Bed in common area with twin trundleGuest: King sized bed, shared bathGuest/Bonus: 2 Twin sized beds, private balconyAREA ATTRACTIONS:Seacrest Beach is a tranquil coastal community nestled along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Known for its colorful Florida cottage-style homes, the neighborhood offers a relaxed, bike-friendly atmosphere with streets named like Flip Flop Lane and Beach Bike Way. The centerpiece is the expansive 12,000-square-foot Seacrest Lagoon Pool, one of the largest private pools in Florida, surrounded by lush landscaping and an amphitheater for community events. Residents and guests enjoy deeded beach access via a boardwalk or seasonal tram service, making it easy to reach the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters. The Village of South Walton serves as the town center, featuring Peddler’s Pavilion—a hub for bike rentals, casual dining, and boutique shopping. The community also boasts shaded walking trails, a farmers' market, and a relaxed pace that appeals to families and vacationers seeking both serenity and convenience.​Show less
